claim_boundary: One local single-entity USD profile: 1000 native three-human cash/equity postings, four workers, and warmed alternating reads of the same effects. Repository latency includes synthetic authentication. Not HTTP TPS, mixed ERP capacity, production sizing, SLO, failover or competitor comparison.

limits: native repository latency includes synthetic identity authentication
no cost per transaction without a supplied resource cost model
measurement.telemetry_policy: read-only 10-second sampled resources on owned synthetic fixture; no production DSN or row content
measurement.postgres_io_timing_interpretation: blk_read_time_ms/blk_write_time_ms are cumulative pg_stat_database counters; zero milliseconds with track_io_timing=off do not prove zero I/O latency; no I/O peak is measured

verified_reads.measurement_scope: authenticated native verified effect reads; no HTTP or database-internal query count

resource_sampling.scope: sampled peaks can miss shorter spikes; client lifetime RSS differs from Python allocation peak

resource_summary.scope: Observed maxima of 10-second samples, not CPU/memory/I/O peaks. Counter deltas span first-to-last samples after fixture seeding and include measured reads and sampler queries; Docker display values are rounded.
resource_summary.process_lifetime_peak_scope: Windows lifetime working-set high-water mark starts before benchmark admission; not a benchmark-only peak.
resource_summary.io_timing_interpretation: blk_read_time_ms/blk_write_time_ms are cumulative pg_stat_database counters; zero milliseconds with track_io_timing=off do not prove zero I/O latency; no I/O peak is measured
